1.text: The collaboration graph is currently assembled and published exactly once, at the end of the plan, after the final whole-branch review.

2.text: The consent check moves from the Finish section to Setup, immediately after the ledger is created and before Task 1 is dispatched.

3.text: The consent prompt must describe a live, updating feed rather than a one-time finished-work summary.

4.text: The four scope flags and the rule that a hedged answer is not consent for annotationText must carry over unchanged from the existing consent gate.

5.text: On a clear yes, the agent must publish an initial skeleton sheet immediately, before Task 1 dispatches.

6.text: After every Task <N>: complete ledger line, clean or parked-at-cap, the agent must run scripts/sdd-publish, cluster the printed substates into states, and call publish_graph.

7.text: Each scripts/sdd-publish call must re-check .governed-superpowers/sharing.json for revocation and skip silently, without erroring the task loop, if consent has been revoked.

8.text: State clustering must be recomputed from scratch by the agent on every publish call, not assigned once and left sticky.

9.text: Each publish call must resend the full accumulated payload, replacing the sheet's prior contents, rather than sending an incremental delta.

10.text: The existing end-of-plan publish offer in subagent-driven-development's Finish section must be removed.

11.text: A new script, scripts/sdd-publish, must be added alongside the existing sdd-workspace, task-brief, and review-package scripts.

12.text: scripts/sdd-publish must assemble and print the substate list (with matched sources) for the controlling agent to cluster and send, never calling publish_graph or deciding state groupings itself, the same division of labor review-package uses for diffs handed to a reviewer.

13.text: scripts/sdd-publish must never read or write .governed-superpowers/sharing.json itself; only the agent's own consent-gate step may write it.

14.text: A scripts/sdd-publish call made without active consent must skip silently and exit 0, never surfacing as a task-loop error.

15.text: This change must be verified via eval evidence and manual dry runs, per this project's existing bar for skill-content changes, not via an automated unit-test suite.
